rationale: The portfolio already holds a full-sized short position in MRNA (4.9% of buying power), and the stock is currently bouncing off its $180.80 intraday low to test the 5-minute 9-EMA at $185.89 on rising 1-minute volume. Adding to the short while short-term momentum is turning up and price is extended ~10% below VWAP offers poor incremental risk-reward, while going long would conflict with our existing short exposure and the strong intraday downtrend.
